status: post-outcome paired-support resource/roost mechanism attribution; frozen before vertical paired output
role: test whether source-provided potential-roost distance plus local land-cover context explains centered vertical individuality beyond 5-km place and source HMM state

linkage.method: bijective nearest-neighbour matching in projected x-y

fixed_context.vertical_centering: full retained source-track median before ARM/COM filtering

paired_estimand.base_model: P(centered z | 5-km cell x source HMM state)
paired_estimand.context_model: P(centered z | 5-km cell x source HMM state x frozen potential-roost-distance bin x main_clc2_ratrel)
paired_estimand.event_pool: ARM/COM observed GPS events deterministically linked to their source RSF used rows
paired_estimand.target_support: score both models only on target events whose full resource-context stratum is supported in both self and other context profiles and whose corresponding base stratum is supported in both base profiles
paired_estimand.target_matching: identical target events for base and context models
paired_estimand.other_weighting: pool source tracks within each other bat then equal-weight other bats within cohort
paired_estimand.target_aggregation: equal target track within bat, then equal bat
paired_estimand.paired_increment: resource-context identity gain minus base HMM-state identity gain; negative indicates attenuation after measured roost/resource context is conditioned

calibration.preserve: track x-y-HMM-state-resource-context-centered-z block and exact per-cohort track-count multiset per identity
calibration.primary_test: observed paired context increment < permutation null mean and one-sided p(null <= observed) <= 0.05

interpretation_matrix.attenuation_PASS: Measured potential-roost distance plus local land-cover context removes more same-individual predictive advantage than expected on identical target support, supporting persistent resource/central-place allocation as a contributor.
interpretation_matrix.attenuation_FAIL: Measured potential-roost distance plus local land-cover context does not measurably attenuate identity on support-matched events; these measured contexts are not supported as a sufficient explanation.

claim_boundary: DistanceAssumedRoostsInKm is source-defined distance to the closest potential roost, not proof of the actual occupied daytime roost for every event
main_clc2_ratrel is source-provided local land-cover context, not exact prey or feeding-resource identity
this is post-outcome mechanism localization, not confirmatory replication
a PASS identifies contribution relative to these measured proxies, not a unique causal mechanism
a FAIL does not exclude exact feeding patches, sub-50-m habitat, local atmosphere, morphology, memory or experience
this is the final same-source Nyctalus mechanism family; do not open additional context variants after its output
